conventions_ruled_here_binding_for_ezeki.ruling: The strategy states the messenger cutting rule three ways (line 62: 'the addressee changes or a close stands before it'; lines 153-154: 'the addressee changes ... or a refrain close stands immediately before it'; lines 322-323: 'a messenger formula with an addressee change'). ONE formulation governs: a messenger formula is a sub-onset when (a) the addressee changes, or (b) the verse immediately before it ENDS on a close-role formula (utterance or recognition, any inventoried or D3 variant) — VERSE-FINAL, not mid-verse. A mark alone never satisfies limb (b). Lines 322-323 are an incomplete summary, not a third rule. The same two limbs govern 'and you, son of man' (ve'attah) inside an already-open unit: it is a sub-onset when the addressee changes or the unit has closed on a verse-final close-role formula before it; a renewed command to the same addressee after a verse-final UTTERANCE signature is a paragraph (the utterance role: 'mid-unit occurrences are paragraph-final ... unless a fresh onset follows').

MEDIUM_LOW: a seam whose near-face signal is itself weak (mid-verse formula; discourse turn without formula) with an empty far face, or a region §7 holds without bespoke rationale. LOW: a seam without a licensed text signal, or where the strategy directs low. §7's direction is the tie-breaker where it names the region. Applied here ONLY to the 25 proposals; no row's confidence is raised unasked.
